title: Readymade Service State
description: Configuration state for a Readymade service instance, generated from indexed service contracts.

cols.description: [ASCII Art] Number of character columns in the output grid

rows.description: [ASCII Art] Number of character rows in the output grid

charset.description: [ASCII Art] Ordered character ramp from lightest to darkest

invert.description: [ASCII Art] When true, reverses the luminance mapping (dark → light characters)

imageKey.description: [ASCII Art] Key on the incoming object that holds the Blob

asset.description: [Asset] The reference emitted when the input names none, e.g. "hkp-asset://card"

sampleRate.description: [Audio Encode] What the incoming samples are

stream.description: [Text Generation] Generate token by token and notify the growing text as {streamText} (final notification carries streamDone: true) for live chat-bot-style display; the pipeline output is unaffected and still emitted once, when generation finishes. Set false for servers without SSE support

maxLength.description: [Audio Editor] Maximum number of samples to retain (default = 60 s at 48 kHz)

action.description: [Hold] Forgets the held value and resets the counts.

action: \"play\" params.description: [Audio Editor] Sample range to play back

selectedBoard.description: [Board Service] Name or identifier of the saved board to run

result.description: [Board Service] Internal — used by the UI to deliver a result back into the pipeline

capacity.description: [Buffer] Maximum number of items before an automatic flush

accumulatedOutput.description: [Buffer] When true, each flush emits the full accumulated buffer since the last clear rather than just the current window

cache+.description: [Cache] Merges the given object into the cached value

cacheProperties+.description: [Cache] List of property names to pluck from the config and merge

triggerProcess.description: [Cache] When true, fires the cached value downstream after updating

key.description: [Store] The key to act on, when every pass means the same slot

outputKey.description: [Cache] Key under which the cached file path is returned

persistRoot.description: [Cache] Folder for on-disk persistence, inside the folders boards are given ([Filesystem](./filesystem.md#where-the-files-are)); a relative path is taken from the default one. Empty, or outside them, = memory only

persistMode.description: [Cache] "sha" (default) or "filename" — controls how the on-disk filename is derived

filenameTemplate.description: [Cache] Inja template for the filename when persistMode is "filename". What it renders stays inside persistRoot, whatever the input puts in it

cacheDuration.description: [Cache] Max age before a cached entry is considered stale (e.g. "24h", "7d")

excluded.description: [Cache] List of regex patterns; keys matching any pattern bypass the cache

captureFormat.description: [Camera] MIME type of the captured Blob (e.g. "image/jpeg")

value.description: [Hold] **Browser only.** On a writing end (slot + op: "write"), written into the slot when configured, as though it had arrived as input. The board keeps it, so the slot holds it again after a reload. How a board sets a value nothing in its pipelines produces — a tempo, a limit — and how a facade control changes it. Ignored on a reading end.

emit.description: [SQL] "result" passes the answer on, "input" passes the request through

reset.description: [Smooth] When true, clears current so the next tick re-initialises from scratch

goal.description: [Communication Dispatcher] What the exchange is for

instruction.description: [Communication Dispatcher] Sent as the opening of the question. Not a system message: the decide pipeline may hold something that already has one, or may not be a model at all

states.description: [Communication Dispatcher] "name" or { name, describe }. The enum next is drawn from

stateFrom.description: [Communication Dispatcher] Dotted path to the current state in the input

actions.description: [Timeline] Data emitted when time reaches at

decide.description: [Communication Dispatcher] The pipeline that asks the model

maxContextChars.description: [Communication Dispatcher] Bound on the input shown to the model. 0 = no bound

lastAction / lastReason / lastNext.description: [Communication Dispatcher] Read-only: what it decided, and why

targetServiceUuid.description: [Configurator] UUID of the service to configure

targetRuntime.description: [Configurator] Runtime ID for cross-runtime targeting; omit for same-runtime

passThrough.description: [Configurator] When true, the original value continues downstream after configuring the target

pipeline.description: [Browser Sub-Service] Ordered list of services in the inner pipeline

mode.description: [UUID Generator] Output mode. plain emits the UUID string directly; merge adds a uuid key to the incoming object.

initialState.description: [Reduce] Starting value for reducedState. Also resets the accumulator when updated.

direction.description: [Conversations] ingest: inbound or outbound, unless the input says

state.description: [Conversations] transition: a fixed target, for a step that always moves the same way

conversationFrom.description: [Conversations] Dotted path to the conversation id, e.g. meta.conversationId

inState.description: [Conversations] actionable: which states count as work. **Required**

idleSeconds.description: [Conversations] actionable: only conversations untouched this long

limit.description: [Store] list: how many records to take, oldest first. 0 = all

kind.description: [Conversations] Artifacts: the board's word for what this is

status.description: [Queue] Filter for list: pending, claimed, done, dead

payloadFrom.description: [Queue] Dotted path to the part of the input to send. Empty sends the whole input

idFrom.description: [Queue] Where ack and fail find the message id in their input

lastCount.description: [Store] Read-only: what the last pass saw

error.description: [Telegram Listener] Last error message, if any

cooldown.description: [Debounce] Minimum time between forwarded values, in seconds

secret.description: [Sign] Shared secret used as the HMAC key

method.description: [UUID Generator] UUID version. v4 is random; v1 is time-based.

feedback.description: [Delay] How much of the delayed signal is fed back into the delay line (0–0.999)

mix.description: [Delay] Wet/dry blend (0 = dry only, 1 = wet only)

minConfidence.description: [Detect] Detections scoring below this (0–1) are left out

backend.description: [Text Generation] server (OpenAI-compatible HTTP) or local (in-process GGUF)

ocr.description: [Document Extract] auto, off, or force — see above. true/false are read as auto/off

ocrBackend.description: [Document Extract] OCR engine (paddleocr, tesseract, sceptre, …). Empty lets the library pick

ocrLanguage.description: [Document Extract] "deu", "deu,eng", or ["deu","eng"]. Empty uses the library's default

tables.description: [Document Extract] Include extracted tables in the output

metadata.description: [Document Extract] Include document metadata (author, title, dates)

maxChars.description: [Document Extract] Cap the text handed on; 0 = no cap. Sets truncated when it bites

minCharsPerPage.description: [Document Extract] Below this, a page counts as having no text

minTextCoverage.description: [Document Extract] Below this fraction of pages carrying text, the document is sparse

filename.description: [Download] What the file is offered as

mimeType.description: [Download] The file's type; empty decides it from the input, as above

url.description: [QR Code] Base URL to display as a QR code. Template variables are resolved.

body.description: [Fetcher] Request body (raw JSON string or plain text)

bodyFormat.description: [Fetcher] How the request body is produced (see below)

bodyExpression.description: [Fetcher] Expression evaluated against params to produce the body; used when bodyFormat is "expression"

chunkSize.description: [File Source] Characters per piece; 0 sends each file whole

path.description: [Filesystem] A file or folder inside the folders boards are given. Relative paths are taken from the default one

operation.description: [Storage] What a request naming no op means (default read)

the desktop app's (\"remote\": \"embedde.description: [Filesystem] *Folders boards may use* in the app's settings

conditions.description: [Filter] One or more expression strings to evaluate

expression.description: [FlatMap] Expression evaluated per input item. Should return an array or a value. Uses the same expression syntax and built-in functions as the [Map](./map.md) service.

maxBytes.description: [Gather] The most one group may hold (64 MiB, the coordinator's default frame limit)

maxGroups.description: [Gather] How many groups may be incomplete at once

timeoutMs.description: [RSS] How long one feed gets to answer

stopPropagation.description: [Browser Sub-Service] Whether what the pipeline produced leaves this service — see [SubService](./sub-service.md)

pending.description: [Gather] Read-only: how many groups are incomplete

recording.description: [Timeline] Whether what arrives at a playing own clock's input is kept as actions. Stopping or pausing sets it to false.

delayMs.description: [GIF Recorder] Inter-frame delay in milliseconds (controls playback speed)

maxFrames.description: [GIF Recorder] Maximum number of frames to buffer before stopping automatically

finalize.description: [Sign] **Progressive mode only** — computes and emits the HMAC over all buffered chunks

slot.description: [Hold] The cell to hold in. Set, op says which end this Hold is and the value is not inspected.

op.description: [Hold] Which end. Only read with a slot.

minDelayInMsec.description: [Batcher] Minimum time in milliseconds between batch emissions

pollUrl.description: [HTTP Relay Client] URL to poll for pending requests

respondUrl.description: [HTTP Relay Client] URL to POST the pipeline result back to

authVaultKey.description: [HTTP Relay Client] Vault key for an optional bearer token injected into poll/respond requests

bypassAfterNumberOfPolls.description: [HTTP Relay Client] Auto-bypass after this many polls; null to disable

condition.description: [If] JSON pattern; all key–value pairs must match for the branch to execute

windowLength.description: [FFT] Expected window length in samples (informational; actual length is taken from the input array size)

password.description: [SMTP Email] Write-only: never echoed back. passwordConfigured says whether one is set

enabled.description: [IMAP Email] Whether to listen; persisted, so a saved board reconnects on load

connect.description: [Telegram Listener] Send { connect: true } to start polling

disconnect.description: [Telegram Listener] Send { disconnect: true } to stop polling

running.description: [Timer] Setting to false stops the timer. Setting to true starts it if start is not otherwise specified.

reconnectAttempts.description: [IMAP Email] Attempts since the connection was last up; 0 while connected

inject.description: [Injector] Value to store and emit. Setting this fires an immediate app.next()

injectBinary.description: [Injector] hkp-rt and hkp-node only: base64 payload to store and emit as binary

recentInjection.description: [Injector] Restore the last injected value on board load (set automatically)

plainText.description: [Injector] Treat the stored value as a plain string rather than parsed JSON

parseEventsAsJSON.description: [Input] Parse message bodies as JSON before emitting

itemsFrom.description: [Spread] Dotted path to the array in the input; the input itself by default

lastItems.description: [Iterator] Read-only: how many the last pass iterated

lastFailed.description: [Iterator] Read-only: how many of those threw

as.description: [Join] Put the result under this key. Empty merges at the top level

onFailure.description: [Join] A detour that failed: stop, or merge its { error, service } in place of the result — under as, or under failure without one

n.description: [Limit] Maximum number of elements to keep. Must be ≥ 1.

filter.description: [Local Storage] Key prefix filter. Only keys starting with this string are included. Empty string = all keys.

process.description: [Local Storage] When true, immediately fires the current item list downstream via app.next()

template.description: [Map] The mapping template. See Template Syntax above.

arrayMode.description: [Map] Whether an array input is mapped element by element or as one value.

sensingMode.description: [Map] When true, the Map auto-learns the template from the first input then disables itself.

filterByTerms.description: [Match Filter] List of substrings to block. Any input containing one of these strings is dropped.

logToConsole.description: [Monitor] Print each value to the server's stdout

fileLogPath.description: [Monitor] Append each value to this file, inside the folders boards are given ([Filesystem](./filesystem.md#where-the-files-are)); a relative path is taken from the default one

endpoint.description: [Text Generation] Read-only: the URL this configuration actually reaches

prompt.description: [OpenAI Prompt] System / user prompt prepended to the pipeline value

responseIsJson.description: [OpenAI Prompt] Parse the response as JSON before emitting

voice.description: [OpenAI Prompt] TTS voice (for tts-1 model). One of alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer

injectPrompt.description: [OpenAI Prompt] When true, appends the pipeline value to the configured prompt rather than replacing it

flow.description: [Output] Whether to continue the pipeline after sending

peerName.description: [Peer Socket] Name this peer registers under

targetPeer.description: [Peer Socket] Name of the peer to send to (in Send or Receive and Send modes)

extractIncomingData.description: [Peer Socket] When true, only the data field of the incoming message is injected into the pipeline

peerPort.description: [Peer Socket] Port override for the peer server

peerHost.description: [Peer Socket] Host override for the peer server

peerPath.description: [Peer Socket] Path override for the peer server WebSocket endpoint

topic.description: [Queue] The name the two boards agreed on. Required by publish and consume; an optional filter for list

visibilitySeconds.description: [Queue] How long a claim holds before the message is handed out again

maxAttempts.description: [Queue] Hand-outs without an ack before the message is left alone

reducer.description: [Reduce] Expression evaluated per tick. Uses the same expression syntax as [Map](./map.md).

resetReducer.description: [Reduce] When true, resets reducedState back to initialState on next configure call

feeds.description: [RSS] The subscriptions. Each entry is a URL string, or { url, name }

fetching.description: [RSS] Read-only: whether a round is in flight

arrayIndex.description: [Select] Zero-based index of the element to return

skills.description: [Skill Router] Skills as {action, board, payload}; malformed entries are dropped

noMatch.description: [Skill Router] stop ends the pipeline; forward passes the input to the services after the router

serverUrl.description: [Text Generation] Server backend: base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server

modelPath.description: [Text Generation] Local backend: path to the .gguf file (~ expands)

contextSize.description: [Text Generation] Local backend: context window in tokens

gpuLayers.description: [Text Generation] Local backend: layers to offload to GPU (-1 = all)

from.description: [SMTP Email] Sender address; envelope mode may override it per message

subject.description: [SMTP Email] Subject — configured mode only, and the fallback in envelope mode

allowedRecipients.description: [SMTP Email] Addresses or @domains this may send to. Empty = unrestricted

by.description: [Sort] Name of the property to sort by

waveType.description: [Sound] Oscillator waveform for synth mode. One of sine, triangle, square, sawtooth, organ, soft, fifth

noteDuration.description: [Sound] How long a synth note is held before its release, in noteDurationUnit

noteDurationUnit.description: [Sound] Seconds, or beats of a tempo (see *Envelope*)

attack.description: [Sound] Seconds a synth note takes to rise to full volume

release.description: [Sound] Seconds a synth note takes to fade once it is no longer held

tempoSlot.description: [Timer] **Browser only.** The slot a "beats" duration reads its tempo from, in BPM. See *Beats* below.

drumMap.description: [Sound] Map of note name → drum type for drums mode

trigger.description: [Sound] What to play for an input that names no note of its own, such as a Timer tick: a note name, or in drums mode also "kick", "snare" or "hihat". Unset, such an input plays nothing. A note the input names always wins.

voices.description: [Speech Synth] Available voices (populated by the UI from speechSynthesis.getVoices())

language.description: [Speech To Text] ISO language code (e.g. "en", "de") or "auto" to detect

computeType.description: [Speech To Text] Quantization: int8, int8_float16, float16, float32

device.description: [Speech To Text] auto, cpu, or cuda

refreshToken.description: [Spotify] OAuth refresh token for automatic renewal

clientId.description: [Spotify] Spotify app client ID (needed for token refresh)

lastTotal.description: [Spread] Read-only: how many items the last array had

database.description: [SQL] Which database; services naming the same one share its tables. Empty: derived from the board's title (hkp-node), default (browser). Ignored by databases

statement.description: [SQL] The SQL to run (query, run, exec)

schema.description: [SQL] CREATE TABLE … applied once per board

macros.description: [State] Named macros. Each macro has variables (keys to substitute) and a template (object or array of objects with $value placeholders)

out.description: [Static] The JSON value to emit on every process() call

prefix.description: [Storage] Confines every path to one part of the store

readOnly.description: [Storage] Answers reads and refuses everything else

namespace.description: [Store] Which of the board's tables. Empty is the board's own

keyFrom.description: [Store] Dotted path into the input to take the key from, e.g. meta.messageId

valueFrom.description: [Store] Dotted path to the part worth keeping; the whole input by default

boardName.description: [Browser Sub-Service] Display name for the nested board

runtimeId.description: [Browser Sub-Service] ID of the inner runtime

runtimeName.description: [Browser Sub-Service] Display name of the inner runtime

scope.description: [Browser Sub-Service] Which cells a [hold](./hold.md) inside reaches

cases.description: [Switch] The cases, tried in order. when is an expression over params; pipeline is a list of pipeline entries (see [Browser Sub-Service](./browser-sub-service.md#pipeline-entry-shape)).

ignoreInnerResult.description: [Switch] Answer with the original input instead of the case pipeline's result: the case runs for its effects.

botToken.description: [Telegram Listener] Telegram Bot API token from @BotFather

allowedChatId.description: [Telegram Listener] If set, only messages from this chat ID are forwarded

systemPrompt.description: [Text Generation] Prepended when the input has no system message

thinking.description: [Text Generation] Server backend: force thinking on/off, for a server whose chat template takes the flag; null sends nothing

apiKey.description: [Text Generation] Write-only; takes a {{secret.…}} reference. The runtime's environment is never read

apiKeyConfigured.description: [Text Generation] Read-only: whether a key is configured

thinkingBudgetTokens.description: [Text Generation] Tokens reasoning may use, for a Claude model that thinks on a budget; maxTokens is lifted above it when it is not already

effort.description: [Text Generation] Claude only: low, medium, high, xhigh or max — how much the model reasons and writes. Empty is the model's own default

jsonSchema.description: [Text Generation] Constrains the answer to a shape — see below

temperature, topK.description: [Text Generation] sent while the model is not thinking

keyframes.description: [Timeline] Keyframes per property of the object

length.description: [Timeline] Length in the timeline's unit; 0 is unbounded

loopStart.description: [Timeline] Where the loop starts over from

loopEnd.description: [Timeline] Where the loop starts over; 0 is the length

fps.description: [Timeline] Frames a second an own clock emits

speed.description: [Timeline] Playback speed of an own clock

recordMode.description: [Timeline] Whether a recording keeps the actions it passes over or clears them

placements.description: [Timeline] When each name plays on this timeline

placement.description: [Timeline] The name a driven timeline takes from its driver; "" takes none

periodic.description: [Timer] When true, the timer fires repeatedly at the configured interval. When false, fires once.

periodicValue.description: [Timer] Numeric amount for the repeating interval. Interpreted in periodicUnit.

periodicUnit.description: [Timer] Time unit for periodicValue. Accepts any [moment.js duration unit](https://momentjs.com/docs/#/durations/): "ms", "s", "m", "h", "d", etc., as well as the rates "bpm" and "hz" and, in the browser, "beats".

oneShotDelay.description: [Timer] Delay before a one-shot timer fires.

oneShotDelayUnit.description: [Timer] Time unit for oneShotDelay: "ms", "s", "beats", or any moment.js unit.

immediate.description: [Timer] When true, fires one tick immediately (after ~1 ms) in addition to the normal schedule.

counter.description: [Timer] Overrides the internal trigger counter to a specific value.

triggerCount.description: [Timer] Automatically stops the timer after this many triggers have fired.

tracks.description: [Tracks] The pipelines, in the order their answers appear

reduce.description: [Tracks] Pipeline given { input, results }; empty emits the array

run.description: [Tracks] One at a time, or together

padAssignments.description: [Trigger Pad] Map of pad index → payload to emit

armedPad.description: [Trigger Pad] Index of the currently active/armed pad

\"trigger-pad\".description: [Trigger Pad] Fire the payload of the specified pad

\"clear-pad\".description: [Trigger Pad] Remove the payload assignment for a pad

action: \"generate\".description: [UUID Generator] Triggers immediate UUID generation and emission via app.next()

filePath.description: [WAV Reader] The .wav file, inside the folders boards are given; a relative path is taken from the default one

provider.description: [Workflow Board Builder] AI provider to use

description.description: [Workflow Board Builder] Natural language description of the desired board

inputBoardSource.description: [Workflow Board Builder] Optional existing board JSON to refine or extend

generatedBoardSource.description: [Workflow Board Builder] The generated board JSON (editable in the UI)

gridRows.description: [XY Pad] Number of discrete rows; 0 = continuous

gridCols.description: [XY Pad] Number of discrete columns; 0 = continuous
